text:
alyssa: Kickoff for ZephyrCorp dedicated capacity bring-up. Need to validate slotting, quota windows, and autoscale behavior. Proposed stepped plan: 8min steps at 10%, 30%, 60%, 90%, 110% of booked baseline. Target date Mon 2026-04-06 14:00 PT. Anyone object?

jordan: looks good. Suggest we reserve +15% buffer for priming churn. Also want a cache-warmup policy so prefix caching doesn't hide cold-starts.

samir: +1 on buffer. For autoscale: scale-up aggressive (30s), scale-down conservative (900s). I'll draft a policy with CPU/GPU and queue-length thresholds. We'll monitor p95/p99 latency.

marta: from CS side: renewal at end of May, so we need clean pass by 4/10. Zephyr wants their internal generator run first; ops should mirror that externally. Can we run a coordinated dry-run?

ops-bot: scheduling: shadow-pool available 14:00 PT. Slot mapping tentative: pool-eu-west slots 81-88. Quota template: `quota:92%`, `burst:25%`, `qs-window:60s`. KMS access requested; awaiting confirmation.

alyssa: here's the loadgen command samir/ops will use — please sanity-check and save for runbook:

```
./loadgen --target https://dedicated.zephyr.redwood/engage \
  --steps 240,720,1440,2160,2640 --step-duration 480 \
  --concurrency 40 --headers "x-account:zephyr" --tag priming
```

kevin-cs: I'll prepare stakeholder readout + one-pager (success criteria, fallback, rollback). Quick question: rollback triggers? p99>1.5s or error rate >0.5%?

samir: propose rollback if p99 > 1.5s for two consecutive steps OR error rate >= 0.5% in any step. Also fallback to quantized/model-lite variant if GPU util > 85%.

marta: Capture customer feedback points: ask Zephyr for 3 priority prompts and 5 sample sessions that must not regress; we'll run evals post-load. Also coordinate on SLO language for renewal comms.

jordan: add monitoring checklist: token-cost burn rate, model-pipeline saturations, KV cache hit ratio, queue latencies. Postmortem points if any failure.

alyssa: Action items: samir (autoscale + rollback policy), ops-bot (confirm KMS & finalize slot IDs), kevin-cs (stakeholder readout + one-pager), marta (collect critical prompts + eval harness). Final go/no-go sync at 13:30 PT day-of. :thumbsup:

ops-bot: noted. Will post final slot confirmation and KMS ticket link by EOD.
